candidate: Chindata Hebei Sangyuan Base (环首都·桑园云计算产业基地), Huangying village, Sangyuan town, Huailai County, Zhangjiakou, Hebei: campus locator for Sangyuan phases 1-2 existing data-centre operations
method: The selected point is the area centroid of the quadrilateral formed by the four corner control points printed as X/Y plane coordinates on the official phase 2 site plan (环首都·桑园云计算产业基地建设项目（二期）项目修建性详细规划, sheet 总平面图（调整前）), attached to the Huailai County Spatial Planning Committee Office publicity of 14 March 2024. The printed values are Gauss-Kruger grid coordinates with the zone number 39 prefixed to Y (3-degree zone 39, central meridian 117 E). The sheet states that its coordinates are in metres but does not name the datum; it was read as CGCS2000, the datum that the 2026 Huailai planning sheet for the Jingxi project states for the same grid, and the result was checked against Sentinel-2 imagery (frame_check). The values were converted with pyproj 3.7.1 from EPSG:4527 (CGCS2000 / 3-degree Gauss-Kruger zone 39, with the 39 prefix) to EPSG:4490 (CGCS2000 geographic). CGCS2000 and WGS84 agree to well under a metre at this scale, so no further transformation was applied. The area and centroid were computed with shapely 2.1.1 in the projected grid.

consistency_checks.printed_dimensions: The sheet dimensions the south road between the south-west and south-east points as 104.70 m (computed 104.701 m) and the north road as 37.09 m + 67.60 m = 104.69 m (computed 104.70 m).
consistency_checks.collinearity: The printed west-road point X=4460631.195 lies on the line from the north-west to the south-west point: interpolated Y 39375626.099, identical to the printed value.
consistency_checks.adjoining_phase_3_sheet: The 9 February 2026 approved phase 3 site plan (hl-68448-siteplan.pdf, sheet 8.2 修改后总平面图, land area 26,673.86 m2) prints its red-line corners as X=4460748.67, Y=39375831.68; X=4460505.17, Y=39375846.74; X=4460743.82, Y=39375725.76; and X=4460500.15, Y=39375736.91. Its west edge passes within 0.01 m of the phase 2 sheet's two eastern points (interpolated Y 39375734.860 and 39375727.003 against printed 39375734.854 and 39375726.999), so both sheets share one plane grid and phase 3 adjoins phase 2 on the east. The phase 3 corners enclose 26,341 m2, 1.2 percent less than the stated area, so they are used only for this check.
consistency_checks.note: The four points enclose the 2# and 3# machine-room buildings and their service roads, about 105 m east-west by 172 m north-south, inside the 31,386.72 m2 phase 2 parcel. They are design control points, not the red-line corners, which the sheet does not print.

selected_point.label: Area centroid of the quadrilateral formed by the four printed corner control points of the phase 2 machine-room block

Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026.
frame_check.observation: Drawn on the window, the converted quadrilateral frames a large bright roof block, and the selected point falls on that roof; the converted phase 3 red line frames the adjoining roofed block to the east. A third large roofed block lies across an east-west road about 150-400 m south and 30-230 m east of the point, beside the north-south provincial road. This matches the 17 March 2023 phase 2 land-use analysis sheet (hl-44088-a1.jpg), which outlines the phase 2 site (本期建设范围) with the built phase 1 land (一期建设用地(已建成)) to its south-east across the east-west road and west of 宝平线 (S241), and the phase 2 sheets, which show S241 east of the phase 3 block. The fit is consistent at the 10 m pixel scale with reading the coordinates as CGCS2000; the imagery was used only for this check and does not contribute to the point.
frame_check.relation_to_point: Not used to derive or move the point.

scope_statement: The point locates the Sangyuan campus through the phase 2 machine-room block. It is not a red-line parcel centroid, a building corner, an entrance, the phase 2 110 kV substation or a campus boundary. Phase 1 (33,333.33 m2, title 冀(2021)怀来县不动产权第0012563号) and phase 3 are not separately located; phase 1's buildings lie roughly 150-460 m from the point.
map_services_used: None. No Google, Waze, Apple, Bing, HERE, Yandex, Baidu, Amap, Naver, Kakao or Tencent map, map embed or PeeringDB location was used, and no OpenStreetMap API, Overpass or extract mirror was fetched.
